# Committee notes, November

Renewals for 2027:

- Rent is now £45 for a full plot and £25 for a half plot.
- Members can pay at the hut on Saturday mornings as before, or by bank transfer using the details on the hut noticeboard, with their plot number as the reference.
- Renewals go out by email this year. Members with no email address still get a paper letter in the post.
- The deadline stays 31 January, so 31 January 2027 this time.
- Lyn Moss stays on as secretary and sends the renewals.
